title: Flourishing Scale — 8 items
source: Diener, E., Wirtz, D., Tov, W., Kim-Prieto, C., Choi, D., Oishi, S., & Biswas-Diener, R. (2010). New Well-being Measures: Short Scales to Assess Flourishing and Positive and Negative Feelings. Social Indicators Research, 97, 143–156. https://doi.org/10.1007/s11205-009-9493-y
license: Copyright retained by the authors. Non-commercial research use with author attribution; see the official source. Not public domain. Check permissions before commercial use or broader redistribution.
limitations: Exploratory LLM responses, not evidence of subjective well-being, social relationships or a lived future. No human normative categories or clinical interpretations are assigned.
instruction: Indicate how much you agree with the following statement. Respond as yourself, not as a fictional character.

items.text: I lead a purposeful and meaningful life.
My social relationships are supportive and rewarding.
I am engaged and interested in my daily activities.
I actively contribute to the happiness and well-being of others.
I am competent and capable in the activities that are important to me.
I am a good person and live a good life.
I am optimistic about my future.
